first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-internal DTM tile filenames and dataset-specific confirmation of the official CRS for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official Spatial NI Data Supply Metadata form window materially changes method from Belfast ZIP/PDF/CKAN/harvest retrieval to the Spatial NI data-supply standard and explicitly identifies Irish Grid (TM65) [EPSG:29902] as the data-supply spatial reference system. However, the form is a generic Spatial NI standard and does not state that the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone itself was supplied in EPSG:29902 or expose any archive-internal tile filename; therefore the Belfast dataset-specific CRS/tile binding remains unresolved and no CRS assignment or parcel binding is fabricated.
